A row represents a source occurrence; repeated English and nested fixed template fragments can have separate source rows. Numeric counters, punctuation-only layout, style/key identifiers and variable-only payloads are outside the fixed-human-text rows.

Trigger fields name per-occurrence enclosing source method and exact enclosing if/conditional/switch branch conditions. Rows marked trigger pending require caller activation-policy tracing; their files have partial scope status. Constructors and helpers can have additional callsite guards outside their source body.

English string literals use the TypeScript-decoded literal value. Template expressions preserve their exact source body without backticks, including source escape spellings such as \n or \u00b7 and the original interpolation expressions. Evidence snippets preserve source notation and compact whitespace; they are not rendered screenshots.
